name: falling
source:
A few years ago Youth McBee lost his father and took over the huge heritage. Despite not wanting to, he continued a depressed life while gaining money and beauty. But one day a strange girl suddenly appeared in his house.

[From [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/7329]Freem[/url]]
translation:
几年前，Youth McBee失去了父亲，继承了巨额遗产。他并不情愿，却仍在获得财富与美貌的同时，继续过着压抑的生活。一天，一个奇怪的女孩突然出现在他家中。

（来源：[url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/7329]Freem[/url]）
